pad-v-xs.description: Compact v padding. Default control v pad.

pad-v-md.description: Roomy v padding. Cards, dialogs, headers.

pad-v-lg.description: Between roomy and large v padding.

pad-h-xs.description: Compact h padding. Chips, dense controls.

pad-h-sm.description: Standard h padding. Default control h pad.

pad-h-md.description: Roomy h padding. Buttons, sidenav, toast.

pad-h-lg.description: Between roomy and large h padding.

gap-2xs.description: Smallest sibling gap. Chips, icon clusters, compact controls.

gap-xs.description: Tight sibling gap. Icon-to-label, most control internals.

gap-sm.description: Standard sibling gap. Lists, tabs, cards.

gap-md.description: Wide layout gap. Roomy stacks. Use pad-v-md / pad-h-md when 16px is padding.

gap-lg.description: Between roomy stacks and section separation.

none.description: No stroke. A side or state with no border — accordion, table, grabber.

default.description: Default stroke weight — chips, banner, buttongroup, inputs.

emphasis.description: Emphasis stroke weight — selected filterchip, heavier container chrome.

none.description: No rounding; flat edge in compound shapes (accordion, combobox, nav joins).

xs.description: Compact rounding — chips, icons, inputchip, tab partials.

sm.description: Default surface rounding — card, input, dialog, listitem, toast.

md.description: More prominent rounding — statictoggle, softer bounded controls.

lg.description: Larger corner radius above md, short of a pill.

full.description: True circle — avatar, radio, slider thumb, presence.

4.description: Micro fixed size — nav notch, indicator. Was size/xxs.

8.description: Smallest icon slot — bullet, compact glyph. Was size/xs.

12.description: Compact icon slot — badge, nav icon. Was size/sm.

16.description: Standard icon slot — avatar, badge, popover, radio. Was size/md and size/lg.

20.description: Compact inline row — divider, chip icon, timepicker. Was size/xl.

24.description: Compact control height — chip, alertchip, inputchip. Was size/2xl.

28.description: Between compact and standard control — buttongroup, calendar, stepper. Was size/3xl.

32.description: Default control height — input, select, tab, combobox. Was size/4xl.

36.description: Table header, sidenav tab, and avatar placeholder.

40.description: Large control / toolbar row — nav, datepicker trigger. Was size/5xl.

48.description: Avatar, spinner, toggle track, and table body.

52.description: Wide control minimum — input min-width. Was size/6xl.

64.description: Chrome band — app header, searchfield, avatar lg. Was size/7xl.
